documentNotes.title: ANSWER SHEET FOR PROBLEM No. 2
documentNotes.statement:
Contestant code

Task no. 1

a.1. Positions of at least five spots, for $d_1 = 30$ cm.

a.2. The value of the constant of the diffraction grid and the magnitude of the measurement error.

a.3. Positions of at least three spots, for $d_2 = 90$ cm.

a.4. The value of the constant of the diffraction grid and the magnitude of the measurement error.

Task no.2

a.1. Positions of at least five spots, for $d_1 = 30$ cm.

a.2. The value of the wavelength of the green radiation and the magnitude of the measurement error.

a.3. Positions of at least three spots, for $d_2 = 90$ cm.

a.4. The value of the wavelength of the green radiation and the magnitude of the measurement error.

Task no. 3

3.a. Positions of at least two spots for at least three distances mirror-screen in the range 25-40 cm, for "strange mirror" 1.

3.b. Setup diagram

3.c. The specific characteristic of "strange mirror" 1, which enables it to reflect a beam into multiple beams.

3.d. Positions of at least two spots for one distance mirror-screen in the range 25-40 cm, for "strange mirror" 2.

3.e. The specific characteristic of "strange mirror" 1, which enables it to reflect a beam into multiple beams.

transcription.notes: The problems file is the experimental Problem No. 2 of RMPh 2012 (printed page numbers 7–15 of 15); it is emitted as one problem with number 2 and title "PROBLEM No. 2". Pages 3–9 are the answer sheet (empty answer boxes with a "Contestant code" frame); its prompts are kept in paper.documentNotes, the empty boxes are not figures. Points: the problem statement prints no points; part points are taken from the official marking scheme (Punctaj column), which totals 10p; section totals are not printed and are left null. The solutions file also contains the solution of Problem No. 1 (theory-style answers on pages 1–2), which belongs to a different paper and is not used; only pages 3–4 (Problem No. 2) are attached. The official marking scheme for Problem No. 2 is printed in Romanian and is transcribed verbatim in Romanian; the table layout (columns Nr. item / Punctaj) is rendered as sections and parts with the item points in bold after each line. Printed content kept as is: 3.e (in the statement and on the answer sheet) asks about "strange mirror" 1 although the task concerns mirror 2 (the scheme computes a_O2 for „oglinda 2”). The phrase "as you might make them to malfunction" is kept as printed. In 3.b of the scheme the 0,20p bullet stands next to the sketch (solution figure p2-sol-fig1). The PDF text layer of the solutions uses a legacy font encoding for ț (shown as Ń); the page shows ț. Task 2.c prints „observe al least three spots” (a typo for „at least”); kept as printed.

problems.title: PROBLEM No. 2
problems.statement:
The goals of this experimental task are:

- determining the constant of a diffraction grid
- determining the wavelength of a pointer laser with green light
- determining a specific characteristic of some "strange mirrors", made of a plastic sheet with a reflective layer, and producing multiple reflected beams for an incident beam

**Experimental setup**

On the bench you will find:

- a ruler-screen (A) for observing spots of light
- a T-shape ruler (B) serving as optical benchmark
- two laser pointers with red and green light respectively (the wavelength of the red light is 650 nm)
- a wooden piece (C) supporting the diffraction grid
- a wooden piece (D) in which to insert the laser pointer
- a wooden piece (E) supporting two "strange mirrors", labeled 1 and 2

**CAUTION**

Be careful not to look directly into the laser beam and not to point the pointer toward anyone! Do not touch the emitting end of the laser pointer, the diffraction grid or the "strange mirrors", as you might make them to malfunction.

You will have to observe positions of various spots on the ruler-screen and write down the observed values within a 1 mm precision. When you insert the laser pointer into piece D, the ON/OFF button will be automatically pressed and the pointer will light.

figures.alt: Photograph of the experimental setup on a blue marble-patterned bench: a long white ruler-screen labeled A along the front edge, a transparent T-shape ruler labeled B perpendicular to it, and along B three small wooden pieces labeled C (diffraction grid holder), D (laser pointer holder) and E (holder of the strange mirrors), letters in red.

sections.title: Task no. 1
sections.statement: Place the diffraction grid at $d_1 = 30$ cm and use red light.

parts.label: 1.a.
parts.statement: Observe at least five spots on the ruler-screen and write down their positions.

parts.label: 1.b.
parts.statement: Determine the constant of the diffraction grid and specify the magnitude of the measuring error.

parts.label: 1.c.
parts.statement: Change the distance to $d_2 = 90$ cm and observe at least three spots on the ruler screen, writing down their positions.

parts.label: 1.d.
parts.statement: Determine the constant of the diffraction grid using these values and specify the magnitude of the measuring error.

sections.title: Task no. 2
sections.statement: Place the diffraction grid at $d_1 = 30$ cm and use green light.

parts.label: 2.a.
parts.statement: Observe at least five spots on the ruler screen and write down their positions.

parts.label: 2.b.
parts.statement: Determine the wavelength of the green light and specify the magnitude of the measuring error.

parts.label: 2.c.
parts.statement: Change the distance to $d_2 = 90$ cm and observe al least three spots on the ruler screen, writing down their positions.

parts.label: 2.d.
parts.statement: Determine the wavelength of the green light using these values and specify the magnitude of the measuring error.

sections.title: Task no. 3
sections.statement: Place the green laser pointer so that light reaches the screen after reflecting on the "strange mirror" labeled 1.

parts.label: 3.a.
parts.statement: Set up the system so that you can observe at least two spots and write down their positions. Do measurements for at least three distances mirror-screen in the range 25-40 cm.

parts.label: 3.b.
parts.statement: Draw a diagram of your setup.

parts.label: 3.c.
parts.statement: Using the data found determine the specific characteristic of "strange mirror" 1 that enables it to reflect one beam into multiple beams.
parts.statementAfter: Place the green laser pointer so that light reaches the screen after reflecting on the "strange mirror" labeled 2.

answer.note: Official scheme: grating constant of mirror 1 a = 1,6 µm (CD).

parts.label: 3.d.
parts.statement: Set up the system so that you can observe at least two spots. Do a measurement just as at point 3.a, for one distance in the range 25-40 cm.

parts.label: 3.e.
parts.statement: Using the data found determine the specific characteristic of "strange mirror" 1 that enables it to reflect one beam into multiple beams.

answer.note: Official scheme: grating constant of mirror 2 a = 0,7 µm (DVD). The statement prints "strange mirror" 1 in 3.e although the task concerns mirror 2.

figures.alt: Sketch of the setup for task 3: from a reflection diffraction grating at the right (labeled „Rețea de difracție prin reflexie”) five beams fan out to a screen at the left at distance d; the angles θ1 and θ2 are marked on each side of the central beam and the spot separation ℓ is marked on the screen.

parts.label: 1.a.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- precizarea poziției a cel puțin cinci spoturi luminoase **0,50p**

parts.label: 1.b.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- $a = k \cdot \lambda_{red} \cdot \dfrac{\sqrt{d^2 + \ell^2}}{\ell}$ **0,80p**
- $x = \dfrac{d}{\ell};\quad \delta x = \dfrac{d \cdot \delta\ell + \ell \cdot \delta d}{\ell^2}$ **0,20p**
- $\delta a = k \cdot \lambda_{red} \cdot \dfrac{x \cdot \delta x}{\sqrt{x^2 + 1}}$ **0,80p**
- *exemplu:* $\begin{cases} d_1 = 30{,}0\ \mathrm{cm} \\ \ell_1 = 10{,}6\ \mathrm{cm} \end{cases}$
- $a = (2{,}0 \pm 0{,}2)\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ **0,80p**
- *Observație:* pentru $a = (2{,}0 \pm 0{,}5)\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ se acordă doar 0,40p

parts.label: 1.c.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- precizarea poziției a cel puțin trei spoturi luminoase **0,30p**

parts.label: 1.d.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- *exemplu:* $\begin{cases} d_2 = 90{,}0\ \mathrm{cm} \\ \ell_1' = 31{,}0\ \mathrm{cm} \end{cases}$
- $a = (2{,}0 \pm 0{,}2)\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ **0,80p**
- *Observație:* pentru $a = (2{,}0 \pm 0{,}5)\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ se acordă doar 0,40p

parts.label: 2.a.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- precizarea poziției a cel puțin cinci spoturi luminoase **0,50p**

parts.label: 2.b.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- $\lambda_{green} = a \cdot \dfrac{\ell}{k \cdot \sqrt{d^2 + \ell^2}}$ **0,40p**
- $x = \dfrac{d}{\ell};\quad \delta x = \dfrac{d \cdot \delta\ell + \ell \cdot \delta d}{\ell^2}$ **0,20p**
- $\delta\lambda_{green} = \dfrac{1}{k} \cdot \dfrac{\delta a \cdot (1 + x^2) + a \cdot x \cdot \delta x}{(x^2 + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}}}$ **0,80p**
- $\lambda_{green} = (550 \pm 10)\ \mathrm{nm}$ **0,80p**
- *Observație:* pentru $\lambda_{green} = (550 \pm 30)\ \mathrm{nm}$ se acordă doar 0,40p

parts.label: 2.c.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- precizarea poziției a cel puțin trei spoturi luminoase **0,30p**

parts.label: 2.d.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- *exemplu:* $\begin{cases} d_2 = 90{,}0\ \mathrm{cm} \\ \ell_1''' = 25{,}2\ \mathrm{cm} \end{cases}$
- $\lambda_{green} = (550 \pm 10)\ \mathrm{nm}$ **0,80p**
- *Observație:* pentru $\lambda_{green} = (550 \pm 30)\ \mathrm{nm}$ se acordă doar 0,40p

parts.label: 3.a.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- precizarea poziției a două spoturi luminoase, pentru cel puțin trei distanțe dintre „oglinda 1” şi ecran **0,30p**

parts.label: 3.b.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- desenarea unei schițe a montajului folosit **0,20p**

parts.label: 3.c.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- $a_{O_1} = \lambda_{green} \cdot \dfrac{\sqrt{d'^2 + \ell'^2}}{\ell'}$ **0,30p**
- *exemplu:* $\begin{cases} d' = 30{,}0\ \mathrm{cm} \\ \ell' = 11{,}0\ \mathrm{cm} \end{cases}$
- $a_{O_1} = 1{,}6\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ (CD) **0,30p**

parts.label: 3.d.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- precizarea poziției a două spoturi luminoase, pentru o distanță dintre „oglinda 2” şi ecran **0,30p**

parts.label: 3.e.
parts.statement:
Pentru:

- $a_{O_2} = \lambda_{green} \cdot \dfrac{\sqrt{d''^2 + \ell''^2}}{\ell''}$ **0,30p**
- *exemplu:* $\begin{cases} d'' = 18{,}0\ \mathrm{cm} \\ \ell'' = 18{,}0\ \mathrm{cm} \end{cases}$
- $a_{O_2} = 0{,}7\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ (DVD) **0,30p**
